maddeler.e:
اهتلكن (form VIII)
# اِهْتَلَكْنَ (ihtalakna) /ih.ta.lak.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# اُهْتُلِكْنَ (uhtulikna) /uh.tu.lik.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# اِهْتَلِكْنَ (ihtalikna) /ih.ta.lik.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
